name: upvital
description: UpVital monorepo root — test orchestration only. App code lives in mobile/, backend/, web/. This file has no dependencies and is never installed or deployed (Railway deploys run from backend/).

scripts.test: npm --prefix backend run test && npm --prefix mobile run test && npm --prefix mobile run audit:check
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix mobile run lint
scripts.format: npm --prefix backend run format && npm --prefix mobile run format
scripts.format:check: npm --prefix backend run format:check && npm --prefix mobile run format:check
